_salesTaxCreditSource: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/taxes/income-taxes/personal/credits/sales-tax — TICKET-026: BC Sales Tax Credit (Form BC479, refundable, T1 line 47900). Single filer: $75 max, reduced 2% of net income over $15,000 (fully phased out at net income ≥ $18,750). Spousal variant ($75 extra, family-net-income threshold $18,000) NOT modelled — engine has no spouse/marital-status concept. Stable since 2013; verified against WS export at net income $14,535 (credit=$75.00) and $16,129 (credit=$52.42→$52), both matching to the cent.
